ops.name: nodes
ops.note: Fetch real-time availability for a batch of variant GIDs in a single round-trip so the widget can surface accurate in-stock/out-of-stock state before the customer confirms

ops.name: cartCreate
ops.note: Create a new cart containing the selected bundle variant line items and embed the earned-tier discount code in one call via CartInput.discountCodes

ops.name: cartLinesAdd
ops.note: Add the selected bundle variant line items to an already-existing customer cart when cartCreate is not applicable

ops.name: cartDiscountCodesUpdate
ops.note: Apply the earned tier discount code to the cart after lines are present, covering the existing-cart flow where cartCreate was not used

webhooks.note: Delivers the full order payload including order id, line items with variant identifiers and quantities, discount codes applied, and order total — all signalFields needed to identify bundle purchases and record history

webhooks.trigger_event: a variant's inventory level reaches zero or recovers above zero
webhooks.note: Fires whenever an inventory level changes and delivers inventory_item_id and available quantity, allowing the system to detect zero-crossing or recovery; variant_external_id is resolved via a downstream lookup on inventory_item_id

webhooks.trigger_event: a product variant is permanently deleted
webhooks.note: Fires when a variant is removed from a product; the payload's variant_gids list reflects the post-deletion state, making removed variant GIDs detectable by diffing against stored bundle items — no dedicated variants/delete topic exists in the catalog
